給你一句標準的日文,你跟著唸,AI 告訴你哪個音不準、語調哪裡跑掉。好處是每一句: You're given a model Japanese sentence and repeat it, and the AI tells you which sounds are off and where your intonation drifts. The upside is that every sentence is a correct model, so your speech doesn't get sloppier over time; the downside is that it feels more like an exercise than a real chat. For beginners through intermediate learners, or anyone who has never felt confident about their pronunciation, this is the safest place to start.

This is closer to real conversation and trains the ability to build sentences on the spot. But if your foundation is too weak, it often turns into an awkward standoff where you can't get a word out and the AI just keeps waiting. We generally recommend starting at around N4 level or higher, when the payoff is much clearer.
